messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter of 18 September asks for firm, long-term commitments. The attached packages give you exactly that: a binding full-volume commitment over 24 or 36 months, which secures your capacity planning. One variant offers a longer lead time to ease your workload. Which lead time can you confirm at the earliest?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, your should-cost estimates do not reflect our specialized manufacturing processes, and our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We note the volume increase and offer EUR 31.50 for a 24-month contract at 23400 units per year. A lead time of 56 days is the earliest we can confirm without a premium. 

Consequently, our offer stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – revised packages for a firm full-volume commitment
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for verifying our data and for offering the full 23400 pcs per year over 24 months.

We have moved a clear step towards you in the attached packages. Each is a binding commitment of 23400 pcs per year, for 24 or 36 months, which secures your capacity planning as your letter of 18 September asks. One package accepts your 56-day lead time. The others keep our 42-day need.

Could you put these packages before its next meeting? Could you also tell us what a shorter lead time would require on your side?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – revised packages for a firm full-volume commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your revised packages and acknowledge your movement. 

Regarding your question, a shorter lead time requires a price premium to accommodate the necessary adjustments in our production schedule. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We propose a price of €31.40 per unit for a volume of 23400 pcs per year over a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
